en.name: A Nameless Adventurer's Notes
en.description: Notes left by an adventurer of an unknown era. In them, they recorded their adventures in Ochkanatlan.
en.source: Vaulting the Wall of Morning Mist

fr.name: Notes d'un aventurier anonyme
fr.description: Notes left by an adventurer of an unknown era. In them, they recorded their adventures in Ochkanatlan.
fr.source: Vaulting the Wall of Morning Mist

en.name: Dreams of the Ancient Capital
en.description: A book about a young woman named Lycia who sets out on a journey alone following the ruination of her homeland at the hands of a black dragon.
en.source: Northernmost island in the Broken Sea

fr.name: Rêves de l'ancienne capitale
fr.description: A book about a young woman named Lycia who sets out on a journey alone following the ruination of her homeland at the hands of a black dragon.
fr.source: Northernmost island in the Broken Sea

en.name: King of Invokations (Book)
en.description: A light novel centered around the most popular card game in Teyvat — Genius Invokation TCG. The characters are unique and the story is exciting and full of twists, making it one of the hottest new works around.
en.source: On a shelf in the Duel! The Summoners' Summit! area at Mondstadt

fr.name: Le roi des invocations
fr.description: A light novel centered around the most popular card game in Teyvat — Genius Invokation TCG. The characters are unique and the story is exciting and full of twists, making it one of the hottest new works around.
fr.source: On a shelf in the Duel! The Summoners' Summit! area at Mondstadt

volumes.location: Obtained during Project Moongazer (Part 1)
Picked up from an Edict Module in Lusalim's Laboratory
Obtained during Project Moongazer (Part 1)
Picked up from an Edict Module in Lusalim's Laboratory

en.name: Onibudou
en.description: A standalone volume from the light novel series "Onibudou," written by Junkichi, a writer with Yae Publishing House. This collection contains the first two major arcs in the story. The quality of the serialized version varies quite a bit, but it still enjoys a degree of popularity amongst readers.
en.source: On a cabinet to the right of Yae Publishing House

fr.name: Onibudo
fr.description: A standalone volume from the light novel series "Onibudou," written by Junkichi, a writer with Yae Publishing House. This collection contains the first two major arcs in the story. The quality of the serialized version varies quite a bit, but it still enjoys a degree of popularity amongst readers.
fr.source: On a cabinet to the right of Yae Publishing House

pageTitle: Somewhat Aged Copy of "Tequil the Brave"

en.name: Somewhat Aged Copy of "Tequil the Brave"
en.description: Somewhat Aged Copy of "Tequil the Brave."
en.source: Threadlike Whispers

fr.name: Copie un peu vieillie de « Tequil le brave »
fr.description: Somewhat Aged Copy of "Tequil the Brave."
fr.source: Threadlike Whispers

pageTitle: Spanking New Copy of "Tequil the Brave"

en.name: Spanking New Copy of "Tequil the Brave"
en.description: Spanking New Copy of "Tequil the Brave."
en.source: Threadlike Whispers

fr.name: Copie complètement neuve de « Tequil le brave »
fr.description: Spanking New Copy of "Tequil the Brave."
fr.source: Threadlike Whispers

en.name: "Of Mountains and Seas"
en.description: Original: Notes penned by Leonard, an adventurer from the distant past. Clearly an ancient text, it has suffered much wear and tear. Most of the content has been lost to the ravages of time, with just a few fragments remaining. After decipering: Notes penned by Leonard, an adventurer from antiquity. Most ancient indeed. Mona has used her astrology to interpret its tattered contents and restore them.
en.source: Where Ancient Stars Align

fr.name: Aventures en montagne et en mer
fr.author: Léonard
fr.description: Le livre existe en 2 versions : la première ravagée par le temps et la seconde traduite par Mona.
fr.source: Where Ancient Stars Align

en.name: 1000 Years of Loneliness
en.description: The beginning of the Springvale Hunter's tragic fantasy journey. Where did misfortune first befall him? What marks the start and finish of the 1000-year journey of loneliness? Let this first volume of 1000 Years of Loneliness be your guide through the fantastical fog that is the life of Gothson.
en.source: Troublesome Work quest reward

fr.name: Mille ans de solitude
fr.description: Le commencement de la tragique histoire d'un chasseur de Deauclaire.
fr.source: Donné en récompense à la fin de la quête Livre perdu.

pageTitle: A Preliminary Study of Sangonomiya Folk Belief

en.name: A Preliminary Study of Sangonomiya Folk Belief
en.description: This paper was written by Shihab Purbiruni, a scholar of modern history from Sumeru, two years before the civil war in Inazuma. It details the folk beliefs of Watatsumi Island and the Sangonomiya people, and puts forward some relatively new academic propositions.
en.source: Found in Bourou Village, Watatsumi Island

fr.name: Étude préliminaire des croyances populaires de Sangonomiya
fr.author: Shihab Purbiruni
fr.description: Un texte écrit par Shihab Purbiruni, un historien moderne de Sumeru, deux ans avant la guerre civile d'Inazuma. Il décrit en détail les croyances populaires de l'Île de Watatsumi et des habitants de Sangonomiya, en plus de proposer des positions novatrices d'un point de vue académique.
fr.source: Village de Bourou

en.name: Along with Divinity: Prologue
en.description: "Have you ever thought about what our lives would've been like without the archons?" Come and join the author in an exploration of "divinity" with humor and logic.
en.source: Grand Master's Office

fr.name: Avec les Dieux - Prologue
fr.description: À quoi nos vies ressembleraient sans présence divine ? Accompagnez l'auteur dans l'exploration du thème de la divinité avec objectivité et humour.
fr.source: Grand Master's Office

en.name: An Ode to Khvarena
en.description: Lore reportedly passed down within a lost religious group in the desert. Someone has transcribed it into a script.
en.source: On a table in the House of Daena

fr.name: Une ode à la khvarena
fr.description: Ce chant aurait été transmis oralement de génération en génération par un ordre religieux du désert. On ignore qui l'a transcrit.
fr.source: Sur une table du Foyer de Daena

en.name: Ancient Investigation Journal: Part I
en.description: An investigation journal found in front of the ruins with a circular entrance. Its author seems to have been a member of the aristocracy that once ruled Mondstadt.
en.source: Found in a chest at the Entombed City - Ancient Palace cave door.

fr.name: Journal d'inspection ancien - Partie I
fr.description: Un journal d'inspection retrouvé devant les ruines avec une entrée circulaire. Son auteur semble avoir été membre de l'aristocratie qui dirigeait autrefois Mondstadt.
fr.source: Quête Royaume sous les neiges

en.name: Ancient Investigation Journal: Part II
en.description: An investigation journal found in the basement of the ice-covered ruins. Its author seems to have been a member of the aristocracy that once ruled Mondstadt.
en.source: Found in a chest beneath the ice lake puzzle left of Starglow Cavern.

fr.name: Journal d'inspection ancien - Partie II
fr.description: Un journal d'inspection trouvé dans le sous-sol des ruines couvertes de glace. Son auteur semble avoir été membre de l'aristocratie qui dirigeait autrefois Mondstadt.
fr.source: Found in a chest beneath the ice lake puzzle left of Starglow Cavern.

en.name: Ancient Investigation Journal: Part III
en.description: An investigation journal found in the camp on the sunny side of Dragonspine. Its author seems to have been a member of the aristocracy that once ruled Mondstadt.
en.source: Found on a shelf in a cellar from the left Teleport Waypoint of Starglow Cavern.

fr.name: Journal d'inspection ancien - Partie III
fr.description: Un journal d'inspection trouvé dans le camp du côté ensoleillé des Monts Dosdragon. Son auteur semble avoir été membre de l'aristocratie qui dirigeait autrefois Mondstadt.
fr.source: Found on a shelf in a cellar from the left Teleport Waypoint of Starglow Cavern.

en.name: Biography of Gunnhildr
en.description: A history book on the life of the apical ancestor of the Gunnhildr Clan compiled by Eckhard Gunnhildr, a modern historian of Mondstadt. It consists of fragmented stories and legends from the aristocratic period.
en.source: Inside Dawn Winery

fr.name: Biographie de Gunnhildr
fr.author: Eckhart Gunnhildr
fr.description: L'historien mondstadtois Eckhart Gunnhildr dresse la biographie complète de son ancêtre à travers les légendes de l'époque aristocratique de Mondstadt.
fr.source: Inside Dawn Winery

pageTitle: Debates on the "Viceroy of the East"

en.name: Debates on the "Viceroy of the East"
en.description: The "Viceroy of the East," or "Touzannou" sung of the Watatsumi folk tradition is also known as the "Akuou" all across Raiden's domains. He was the first vassal ruler of the Great Serpent Orobashi, and he was also the last.
en.source: Found in Bourou Village, Watatsumi Island

fr.name: Débats sur le « Vice-roi de l'Est »
fr.description: Le « Vice-roi de l'Est » ou « Touzannou » chanté dans la balade folklorique de Watatsumi est également connu sous le nom d'« Akuou » dans tous les domaines de la Shogun. Il fut le premier roi vassal du Grand serpent Orobashi, et aussi le dernier...
fr.source: Found in Bourou Village, Watatsumi Island

en.name: First Apprentice of Guhua
en.description: A novel by Chang the Ninth. Its thickness and weight say much about the effort he put in.
en.source: This Novel Is Amazing!

fr.name: Premier disciple du Clan Guhua
fr.author: Chang le Neuvième
fr.description: Le roman écrit par Chang le Neuvième. Son épaisseur laisse penser qu'il a passé beaucoup de temps dessus.
fr.source: This Novel Is Amazing!

en.name: Gliding Instruction Manual
en.description: A guidebook for the ones new to using wind gliders. It also serves as a mandatory reading material to get a gliding license in Mondstadt. It contains all the necessary info any user must know.
en.source: Outrider Style Quest

fr.name: Guide de planage
fr.description: Un guide préparé pour les débutants apprenant à utiliser le planeur de vent, lecture essentielle pour quiconque souhaitant obtenir le permis de planer. On y trouve les informations que tout utilisateur doit connaître.
fr.source: Outrider Style Quest

en.name: Handy Handbook of Hilichurlian
en.description: A handbook of Hilichurlian written by the folklorist Ella Musk, though its practical use has yet to be tested in the field.
en.source: Mimi Tomo Event: Mimi Tomo (Quest)

fr.name: Manuel pratique du Brutocollinus
fr.author: Ella Musk
fr.description: Un manuel du Brutocollinus écrit par l'ethnologue Ella Musk. Son application pratique reste à tester sur le terrain.
fr.source: Mimi Tomo Event: Mimi Tomo (Quest)

pageTitle: History of Kings and Clans: Prologue

en.name: History of Kings and Clans: Prologue
en.description: A comprehensive history of Mondstadt edited and compiled by the Northland History Society.
en.source: Grand Master's Office

fr.name: Histoire des rois et des clans - Prologue
fr.description: L'histoire de Mondstadt dans un ouvrage complet rédigé par la Société des historiens du Nord.
fr.source: Dans le bureau de la Grande Maîtresse (QG de l'Ordre).

en.name: Humor From Tianheng
en.description: A poetry collection by Pingshan, The Mystic. The quality of the poems is all over the place, but it has long been a reference book or young poets or poet-wannabes in Liyue.
en.source: In front of Verr Goldet, Wangshu Inn

fr.name: Humour de Tianheng
fr.description: Un recueil de poésie des mystiques du Mont Ping. Bien que la qualité littéraire des poèmes peut être parfois discutable, cet ouvrage a longtemps servi de référence aux apprentis poètes liyuéens.
fr.source: In front of Verr Goldet, Wangshu Inn

en.name: Knights of Favonius Handbook - 5th Edition
en.description: A code of conduct covering language usage and behavioral norms for Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius, personally edited by Acting Grand Master Jean. All knights are expected to strictly abide by these rules and regulate their words and deeds accordingly.
en.source: Question and Answer quest reward

fr.name: Code de l'Ordre de Favonius - 5e édition
fr.author: Jean
fr.description: Un ouvrage qui consigne toutes les règles de conduite de l'Ordre de Favonius, intégralement révisé par Jean, la Grande Maîtresse suppléante. Tous les chevaliers doivent s'y conformer.
fr.source: Question and Answer quest reward

en.name: Let's Go, Dodoco!
en.description: Message From the Editor: "Let's Go, Dodoco!" is the combined work of an older girl and a younger girl. Every chapter brims with their gentleness and good wishes, as the story is intended as a gift to our readers. I hope this book — in spite of its small volume — can bring you some simple joy after a long day of work.
en.source: A Story for You during the Hues of the Violet Garden Event

fr.name: Allez, Dodoco !
fr.description: Message de l'éditeur : « Allez, Dodoco ! » est une œuvre née de la collaboration entre deux filles dont l'une est plus jeune que l'autre. Leur gentillesse et leur bienveillance transparaissaient dans chaque chapitre, car cette histoire est un cadeau qu'elles offrent aux lecteurs. J'espère que ce livre vous fera retrouver le sourire après une longue journée de travail.
fr.source: Festival Irodori

en.name: Linling's Anthology of Selected Poetry
en.description: A collection of poetry that Linling published at her own expense. It is her first publication, and she is very proud of it.
en.source: So-Called Work quest reward

fr.name: Compilation de poèmes de Linling
fr.author: Linling
fr.description: Une anthologie de poèmes que Linling a auto-publié. Ce premier ouvrage rassemble le meilleur de son œuvre.
fr.source: Problèmes au travail

en.name: Lost Adventure Notebook
en.description: A set of adventurer's notes that you picked in the ruins. It seems to contain a clue to unlocking these mechanisms.
en.source: Obtained from Expansive Eya

fr.name: Notes de l'aventurier perdu
fr.description: Un carnet de notes trouvé au milieu de ruines. Il semble renfermer un indice pour l'activation des mécanismes.
fr.source: Obtained from Expansive Eya

en.name: Meadow of Gems
en.description: This scroll, which seems to be a part of a larger series, belongs to the Jade Chamber's invaluable collection of written works. This volume is a dissertation on Liyue Harbor's economic policy.
en.source: Obtained during the quest Return of the Jade Chamber?; Jade Chamber

fr.name: Perle précieuse
fr.description: Ce rouleau fait partie de la collection inestimable de la Chambre de Jade. Ce volume parle de la politique économique de Liyue.
fr.source: Obtained during the quest Return of the Jade Chamber?; Jade Chamber

en.name: Mountainous Miscellany
en.description: This text contains all manner of strange legends about Mt. Tianheng's stones, including tales about many rare ores. It is said that if you stand in the middle of the lake south of Mt. Tianheng at dusk, you will find the legendary Subrosium.
en.source: Picked up during Bygones Times Like Dust Passing

fr.name: Méli-mélo sur les montagnes
fr.description: Ce texte contient toutes sortes de légendes étranges sur les pierres des Monts Tianheng, y compris des histoires sur de nombreux minerais rares. Il est dit que si vous vous tenez au milieu du lac au sud des Monts Tianheng au crépuscule, vous trouverez du subrosium légendaire.
fr.source: Picked up during Bygones Times Like Dust Passing

en.name: Pharmacist's Notebook (I)
en.description: Notes left by Yasumoto. They still smell strongly of Naku Weed.
en.source: On top of some crates in the small campsite, to the north-west of the Fort Fujitou waypoint.

fr.name: Carnet de pharmacien I
fr.author: Yasumoto
fr.description: Des notes laissées par Yasumoto. Elles sentent encore fortement l'herbe à sanglots.
fr.source: On top of some crates in the small campsite, to the north-west of the Fort Fujitou waypoint.

en.name: Pharmacist's Notebook (II)
en.description: Notes left by Yasumoto. It has been conscientiously protected from rain damage.
en.source: On top of a rock next to the trodden path, just before the Narukami Pillar east of Fort Fujitou.

fr.name: Carnet de pharmacien II
fr.author: Yasumoto
fr.description: Des notes laissées par Yasumoto. Elles ont été consciencieusement protégées des dommages causés par la pluie.
fr.source: On top of a rock next to the trodden path, just before the Narukami Pillar east of Fort Fujitou.

en.name: Pharmacist's Notebook (III)
en.description: Notes left by Yasumoto. It shows some signs of blotching and water damage.
en.source: East-Northeast of Yasumoto's house and south-east of the northernmost waypoint, under a tree.

fr.name: Carnet de pharmacien III
fr.author: Yasumoto
fr.description: Des notes laissées par Yasumoto. Elles ont été légèrement abimées par des taches et de l'eau.
fr.source: East-Northeast of Yasumoto's house and south-east of the northernmost waypoint, under a tree.

en.name: Pretty Please, Kitsune Guuji?
en.description: A popular light novel in Inazuma which tells the story of the "good-for-nothing" Shogun and the "good-at-everything" Kitsune Guuji. The novel is in the same collection as "Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power," but not by the same author. What they share in common, however, is their popularity.
en.source: Sold by Kuroda at the Yae Publishing House in Inazuma City; Sold by Murata at the Outlander Affairs Agency in Ritou during the Hues of the Violet Garden event

fr.name: S'il te plaît, ma Guuji Kitsune ?
fr.description: Un roman léger qui connaît du succès à Inazuma. Il raconte l'histoire de la Shogun incapable et de la guuji Kitsune aux talents extraordinaires et se déroule dans le même univers que « Shogun toute-puissante — Comment j'ai été réincarnée en Raiden aux pouvoirs illimités ». Ces œuvres ont des auteurs différents, mais suscitent le même engouement.
fr.source: Vendu par Kuroda à la Chambre Yae à la Cité d'Inazuma Vendu par Murata au Bureau des affaires étrangères à Ritou pendant l'événement "Teintes du jardin violet".

pageTitle: Ragged Notebook (Bygones Times Like Dust Passing)

en.name: Ragged Notebook (Bygones Times Like Dust Passing)
en.description: A ragged notebook you found in the village. It records the happenings of long ago, now buried by the passage of time.
en.source: Picked up during Bygones Times Like Dust Passing

fr.name: Journal décrépit (Quête)
fr.description: Un journal décrépit que vous avez trouvé dans le village. Il raconte des événements qui ont eu lieu dans un passé lointain, enfoui dans les sables du temps.
fr.source: Picked up during Bygones Times Like Dust Passing

en.name: Ragged Notebook (Time and Wind)
en.description: Anonymously authored notes. They describe a place seemingly not far from here.
en.source: In the breakable rock on the south-end of the Nameless Island

fr.name: Journal décrépit
fr.description: Un journal dont le contenu a un rapport avec cet endroit...
fr.source: In the breakable rock on the south-end of the Nameless Island

en.name: Records of a Changing Village
en.description: Documents announcing the villagers' migration. It states the village was forced to relocate due to a god's remains.
en.source: Picked up during Bygones Times Like Dust Passing

fr.name: Archives d'un village en mutation
fr.description: Des documents qui informent de la migration des villageois. Il annonce que le village a dû être déplacé en raison de la présence de restes d'une divinité déchue.
fr.source: Picked up during Bygones Times Like Dust Passing

en.name: Sacred Sakura Cleansing Summary
en.description: A tattered scroll containing information related to the Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual. Some pages seem to bear the cinnabar seal of some shrine.
en.source: Sacrificial Offering

fr.name: Guide de purification du cerisier sacré
fr.description: Un parchemin en lambeaux contenant des informations relatives au rituel de purification du cerisier sacré. Certaines pages semblent porter le sceau cinabre d'un sanctuaire.
fr.source: Sacrificial Offering

en.name: Sangonomiya Chronicles
en.description: Historical annals written by the famous Shogunate historian Kujou Michizane, who was known as the "Kujou Sanpitsu-Tou," or "The Great Calligrapher." It chronicles the history of Watatsumi Island in broad strokes.
en.source: Found in Komore Teahouse

fr.name: Chroniques de Sangonomiya
fr.description: Annales historiques écrites par le célèbre historien du Shogunat Kujou Michizane, connu comme l'un des « Trois dignitaires Kujou » ou le « Grand calligraphe ». Il y relate brièvement l'histoire de l'Île de Watatsumi.
fr.source: Trouvé dans le Salon de thé Komore

pageTitle: Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power

en.name: Shogun Almighty: Reborn as Raiden With Unlimited Power
en.description: A popular light novel in Inazuma which tells the story of a mere mortal suddenly turning into the Raiden Shogun. The story is well-received for its novel plot and has inspired many light novelists.
en.source: Sold by Kuroda at the Yae Publishing House in Inazuma City; Sold by Murata at the Outlander Affairs Agency in Ritou during the Hues of the Violet Garden event

fr.name: Shogun toute-puissante — Comment j'ai été réincarnée en Raiden aux pouvoirs illimités
fr.description: Un roman léger qui connaît du succès à Inazuma. Il raconte l'histoire d'un mortel qui se transforme soudainement en Shogun Raiden. Bien accueillie par la critique pour son intrigue novatrice, cette œuvre est devenue une source d'inspiration pour de nombreux autres auteurs de romans.
fr.source: Vendu par Kuroda à la Chambre Yae à la Cité d'Inazuma Vendu par Murata au Bureau des affaires étrangères à Ritou pendant l'événement « Teintes du jardin violet ».

en.name: Stone Tablet Compilations: Vol. I
en.description: A history book compiled and translated from ancient stone tablets of Liyue by the historian Zichang. It contains various fragmented historical events.
en.source: Mondstadt Library

fr.name: Inscriptions sur tablette de pierre - I
fr.description: Un ouvrage qui compile les traductions des inscriptions trouvées sur les anciennes tablettes de pierre liyuéennes par l'historien Zichang. Elles relatent certains événements historiques.
fr.source: Bibliothèque de Mondstadt

en.name: The Lay of Al-Ahmar
en.description: A story about an ancient god whose name has been lost to history. The story is told by a floating Jinni. The veracity of the story cannot be determined.
en.source: On a table in the House of Daena

fr.name: L'histoire d'Al-Ahmar
fr.description: L'histoire d'une ancienne divinité oubliée. Elle est racontée par un djinn flottant dans les airs. Sa véracité ne peut être attestée.
fr.source: Sur une table du Foyer de Daena

pageTitle: The Life of Mouun the Shrine Maiden

en.name: The Life of Mouun the Shrine Maiden
en.description: For the people of Watatsumi, the legends of the Archon War are always filled with bitterness. Many of these millennia-old folksongs tell of a shrine maiden by the name of Mouun, who once rode upon the back of a sea monster, following the Great Serpent unto a tragic moving end.
en.source: Bourou Village, Watatsumi Island

fr.name: La vie de la prêtresse Mouun
fr.description: Les légendes de la Guerre des Archons laissent encore un arrière-goût amer aux habitants de l'Île de Watatsumi. De nombreuses chansons vieilles de plus d'un millénaire racontent l'histoire d'une prêtresse nommée Mouun qui chevauchait une énorme bête marine pour se battre aux côtés du Grand serpent jusqu'à sa fin tragique.
fr.source: Village de Bourou, Île de Watatsumi

pageTitle: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku

en.name: The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku
en.description: A novel based on Watatsumi Island's folktales. The original edition of this text was transcribed on Watatsumi Island and brought back to Narukami Island by a merchant while the former's serpent god yet lived. No one reads this ancient tome nowadays, its role supplanted by all the light novels on the market. This book describes the unique cosmological outlook of the Watatsumi people before they came to adopt aspects of Narukami culture, and a recent resurgence in traditional novel publishing has allowed it to see the light of day once more.
en.source: Sold by Kuroda at the Yae Publishing House in Inazuma City

fr.name: Le serpent et les dragons de Tokoyokoku
fr.description: Un roman basé sur les contes populaires de l'Île de Watatsumi. L'édition originale de ce texte a été transcrite sur l'Île de Watatsumi et ramenée sur l'Île de Narukami par un marchand alors que l'ancienne divinité serpent vivait encore. Personne ne lit aujourd'hui ce vieux tome, supplanté depuis par tous les romans légers du marché. Ce livre décrit la perspective cosmologique unique des Watatsumiens avant qu'ils n'adoptent des aspects de la culture narukamienne. Une résurgence récente de l'édition de romans traditionnels lui a permis de voir le jour une fois de plus.
fr.source: Après complétion de la quête Recueils des dragons et serpent

pageTitle: The Shepherd and the Magic Bottle

en.name: The Shepherd and the Magic Bottle
en.description: The story of a shepherd who came across a magic bottle within which an unexpected being was confined.
en.source: Table in the House of Daena

fr.name: Le berger et la bouteille magique
fr.description: L'histoire d'un berger qui trouve dans le désert une bouteille en argent dans laquelle est enfermé un personnage inattendu.
fr.source: Table du Foyer de Daena

en.name: Thick Notebook
en.description: Notes written by Henry Morton. They describe a place seemingly not far from here.

fr.name: Journal épais
fr.author: Henry Morton
fr.description: Le journal de Henry Morton. Son contenu a un rapport avec cet endroit...

en.name: Verses of Equilibrium
en.description: Legend has that it contains ancient incantations used to pay respects to Rex Lapis and the yaksha adepti. It also serves as a historical record of the ancient belief in the Geo Archon.
en.source: Wanwen Bookhouse

fr.name: Versets d'Equilibrium
fr.description: ==Texte==
fr.source: Wanwen Bookhouse

en.name: Wind, Courage, and Wings (Book)
en.description: A book mistakenly taken by Amber... about fables?
en.source: Glide With the Wind

fr.name: Vents, courage & ailes (Livre)
fr.description: Un ouvrage de fables qu'Amber a pris par erreur ?
fr.source: Glide With the Wind

en.name: Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti
en.description: A volume out of the 'Hidden Wonders and Folklore of Liyue' collection, which serves as Liyue's own version of 'Tour of the Land of Liyue,' an encyclopedia of folk beliefs and customs by Masudi, a scholar from Sumeru. Due to the archaic nature of the author's writing style, it was largely dismissed by the public and publishers alike. 'Yakshas, The Guardian Adepti' introduces the readers to the various yakshas who fought side-by-side with the Geo Archon.
en.source: Obtained from Glimmers of the Vigilant Yaksha

fr.name: Les Yakshas, gardiens Adeptes
fr.author: Masudi
fr.description: Un volume de la collection « Folklore & merveilles de Liyue », qui est la version réservée à Liyue de la série « Un tour des terres de Liyue », rédigée par le chercheur Masudi de Sumeru. Son style obscur en rend le contenu difficilement compréhensible. « Les Yakshas, gardiens Adeptes » présente les différents Yakshas ayant combattu aux côtés de l'Archon Géo.
fr.source: Obtained from Glimmers of the Vigilant Yaksha
